LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingGasSourceModeDesc: The framework reuses gases and effects that already exist, from the game or from other mods, and carries its own only where nothing else does. This setting overrides that.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_GasSourceModeAutomaticDe: Other mods' and the game's gases where they exist; the framework's own gases where nothing else carries them. The default.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_GasSourceModeAlwaysOwnDe: Every framework gas runs, even where another mod's effect covers it. Mods that read gases then read the framework's.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_GasSourceModeExistingOnl: The framework carries no gas of its own. Mods that depend on one fall back to a simpler estimate, or do nothing.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingShowGasOverlay: Show gases at the mouse (dev mode)
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingKeepGameLogAlive: Keep the game's log going after its message limit
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingKeepGameLogAliveD: RimWorld stops all logging, its Player.log file included, once a session has written 10,000 messages, and only loading a save turns it back on; one mod's repeating error can reach that in minutes, and then nothing that goes wrong afterwards is written down. With this on, the log is turned back on when that happens, at most {COUNT} times a session, and one line names the message that filled it. It changes nothing until the game has stopped its log. Off: the game's own limit stands.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingWritePatchedDefs: Write every Def with all patches applied at the next start (dev mode)
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingWritePatchedDefsD: For mod developers. At the next start, once the game has loaded, every Def is written as it stands after every mod's XML patches (before inheritance) to {PATH}, for phobos-modkit's Def tool. Takes a few seconds and a few hundred megabytes on disk with a large mod list; turns itself off once written. The file holds other authors' Defs: keep it on this computer.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_SettingShowGasOverlayDes: In development mode, a small label follows the mouse naming every gas the framework can see in that cell's room.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_DisplayModePlainDesc: Words only. No percentages, no figures.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_DisplayModeOperatorDesc: The figures a practitioner would want to see.
LanguageData.PhobosFramework_DisplayModeEngineerDesc: The full working, line by line.
